subject.title: test(repair): add hermetic automerge end-to-end flow

question: What image-provenance boundary should this repository require before CI runs the production-style automerge E2E container?
rationale: The code can pin an image mechanically, but deciding whether an externally published digest is acceptable or whether repository-built provenance is required is a security and supply-chain policy choice.

options.title: Publish a repository-built verified base
options.body: Build and publish the base from the checked-in Dockerfile with provenance or attestation, then pin that verified artifact in the E2E Dockerfile.

options.title: Explicitly accept the external digest
options.body: Document and approve the external registry image as the permitted trust boundary, including its owner, rebuild process, and update policy.

options.title: Keep the harness local-only for now
options.body: Defer the Blacksmith workflow until the repository has an approved source-to-image publication path.

recommendation.title: Publish a repository-built verified base
recommendation.body: Build and publish the base from the checked-in Dockerfile with provenance or attestation, then pin that verified artifact in the E2E Dockerfile.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history connects this contributor to the affected repair and E2E implementation, making them the best available routing candidate for the provenance design discussion.
